design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: Swiss & High-Contrast meets Performance Pro (Tactical Jobsite Utility)
emotional_tone: Built for high-glare sunlight and dusty thumbs. Direct, high-contrast, zero-fuss paperwork weapon for contractors standing in boots on a active jobsite.

user_context.viewport_widen_strategy: Single column mobile core (max-w-md mx-auto) on mobile; on desktop (md: and lg:), containers widen gracefully into a max-w-5xl layout with 2-column tactical panels without altering the data architecture.
user_context.touch_target_rule: Strict minimum 48px height for all buttons, inputs, tabs, and list rows (touchable with work gloves or dirty hands).
user_context.primary_demo_trade: Interior & Exterior Painting (seed with real Sherwin-Williams/Benjamin Moore paints, spray rig setup, drywall prep, exterior trim, pressure washing)

forbidden_styles: No gradients anywhere (no gradient buttons, no gradient backgrounds, no gradient text)
No stock illustrations or SVG cartoon characters
No emoji characters in UI labels, badges, or buttons
No centered hero cards or marketing fluff
No transparent backgrounds on headers, navigation, dialogs, dropdowns, or overlays
No Inter for main headings or monetary displays (use heavy industrial sans)
No soft pastel borders or low-contrast muted gray text

typography.font_family_headings: Barlow Condensed, Oswald, 'DIN Alternate', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Inter, 'SF Pro Text', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.money_rule: Money is ALWAYS the largest visual element in any summary card or header. Numbers must be rendered with tabular figures (tabular-nums font-mono) with high-contrast Safety Orange or Crisp High-Contrast White.

summary_tiles_spec.description: Four prominent stat tiles arranged 2x2 on mobile, 4x1 on desktop.

pipeline_groups.description: Jobs grouped by status tab or collapsible vertical sections: Lead, Estimated, Approved, In Progress, Complete, Invoiced, Paid.
job_card_layout: Status Pill Badge top-right (e.g. IN PROGRESS with Safety Orange border)
Client Name & Jobsite Physical Address with quick Google Maps navigation link / icon
Prominent Split Metric Bar: Left = CONTRACT TOTAL ($ large white mono), Middle = COSTS TO DATE ($ slate-300), Right = PROFIT ($ & % in green/red)
Last active field log excerpt or date stamp

header_spec.status_picker: Full-width select or tap-to-cycle status bar with 7 statuses
header_spec.quick_phone_call_action: Tap to call client (tel: link) with min-h-[48px] target
header_spec.hero_cover_photo: Optional jobsite cover photo aspect-ratio [16/9] with overlay

tabs_structure.label: ESTIMATE
tabs_structure.content: Line items table/list (paint gallons, labor hours, pressure washing, masking tape). Unit qty x rate = line total. Inline add line item. Subtotal, Tax toggle, Grand Total in giant orange mono numbers. Button: 'Send / Share Estimate' & 'Convert to Invoiced'.

tabs_structure.label: FIELD LOG
tabs_structure.content: Chronological field logs. Quick photo upload input (simulated camera capture), timestamped notes (e.g. 'Completed 2 coats primer in master bed, dry time 3 hrs'). Quick voice/text log entry form with date/crew tags. Hours entry sub-tab for crew hours tracking.

tabs_structure.label: EXPENSES
tabs_structure.content: Receipt photo thumbnail, vendor (Sherwin-Williams, Home Depot, Sunbelt Rentals), date, amount, category (Materials, Labor, Equipment, Disposal). Big metric at top: Total Job Cost vs Budgeted Cost.

3_clients.list_view: Alphabetical or recent list of clients. Quick search bar by name or street address. Tap to call or tap to open client detail.

detail_view.contact_block: Client name, phone with direct tap-to-call, email with mailto, property address
detail_view.all_jobs_history: History of jobs for this client with dates, status badge, and total revenue billed
detail_view.client_lifetime_value: Big mono number: TOTAL REVENUE COLLECTED

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, card, status badge, and monetary field MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly honor the dark slate (#0B0F17, #131B26) + Safety Orange (#FF5F15) palette. Never add pastel gradients or light purple SaaS colors.

Mobile-first: Keep the core layout single-column centered at max-w-md on mobile so phone users holding a device with one hand have natural thumb access. On md: breakpoints, let the container widen to max-w-5xl with a clean two-column split.
No emojis anywhere in labels or badges. Use Lucide icons: Phone, MapPin, Plus, DollarSign, Calendar, Camera, FileText, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Layers, Building, Clock.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have at least 48px height for easy tapping with dirty hands or gloves.

Ensure complete state persistence via LocalStorage or backend API so the user can add jobs, edit rate card prices inline, add field log notes with photos, log receipts, and see instant live calculations on the Dashboard tiles.

Seed high-fidelity Painting trade data right from the start (20+ realistic paint line items, 4 realistic painting jobs across different status stages: In Progress, Lead, Approved, Paid) so the app immediately feels lived-in and professional.
Include quick mock photo capture/upload so clicking 'Add Photo' lets the contractor upload from their phone camera or select existing job photos seamlessly.
Money values must use US Dollar format ($X,XXX.XX) with bold tabular figures.
